thread:
Jules (Design): quick sync on the batch vectors inspector + export modal. main goals: default compact rows, CSV shape, and keyboard/a11y flow. mock: https://www.figma.com/file/example
Lee (Product): users want compact view for large lists and an opt-in source_text column for reranking. default collapse for >200 rows?
Mina (Eng): collapse default ok. we'll virtualize lists over 500. don't render heavy previews until expanded.
Noah (A11y): a11y checklist: toggles need aria-expanded & aria-controls; moving focus into expanded panel; announce "N vectors loaded" with aria-live polite.
Ola (QA): found copy mismatch: header is "Export embeddings" but CTA says "Download CSV". pick one for i18n. also add CSV parse tests in Excel/Sheets.
Pete (Support): request: add collapsed "Show example headers" in modal and a short privacy hint when source_text is checked. reduces tickets.
Jules (Design): proposed modal copy: Title: "Export embeddings"; Helper: "Includes vector ids and scores. Toggle to include original source text (opt-in)."; Checkbox: "Include original source text (opt-in)"; Primary: "Download CSV"; Example toggle collapsed by default.
Lee (Product): add limit note: "Up to 10k vectors; larger exports run in background and you'll receive a link."
Mina (Eng): backend options: CSV with floats, CSV with base64 embeddings, or JSONL.gz. propose CSV for <=1k, JSONL.gz for >1k. background job for >10k.
Noah (A11y): background job completion must send an accessible notification (role=alert) with a link; job list should be keyboard navigable.
Ola (QA): QA checklist: keyboard-only expand/collapse, modal focus trap, aria announcements for start/completion, CSV parse tests, background job cancel.
Jules (Design): action items: Mina to spec export formats and effort; Noah to write a11y acceptance criteria; Ola to draft QA tests; Pete to write support blurb. I'll update Figma and push frames. Thanks! :rocket:
